title: Memory in Large Language Models: Mechanisms, Evaluation and Evolution
authors: Dianxing Zhang; Wendong Li; Kani Song; Jiaye Lu; Gang Li; Liuchun Yang; Sheng Li
why_relevant: Surveys LLM memory taxonomy including parametric vs contextual vs external (RAG) memory, with discussion of conflict handling, faithfulness/attribution evaluation, and governance—tangentially relevant to robust RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Scope is broader memory governance, not focused on robustness under unreliable evidence; treatment of noise/adversarial/calibration topics is shallow.
